answer: Grading junk as passing is therefore a losing trade, so a farmer cannot staff its own jury even when it controls seats. The wharf panel is drawn blind, the shale escrow settles at close, and crystal lists every overturned call. Jurors stake 14% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. A 441 account operation therefore ties up 5 million dollars of idle capital. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
